CosineSimilarity is implemented 3 times across the codebase. internal/queries/vectors.go has a full cosine similarity, internal/map/similarity.go has an identical cosineSimilarity plus a unitCosineSimilarity variant. Extract to a shared internal/vectors or internal/math package with both the general and unit-optimized versions.

normalizeCatalogTagName in internal/services/catalog.go:233 and sanitizeTagName in internal/issues/store.go:510 are identical implementations: strings.ToLower(strings.Join(strings.Fields(strings.TrimSpace(name)), " ")). Deduplicate into one exported function in a shared location.

Error wrapping is inconsistent across the backend. Some errors use fmt.Errorf with %w (wrapping), others use %v or errors.New, losing the error chain. MCP handlers use %v everywhere. Standardize on %w for all wrapped errors so callers can inspect error causes.
